To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) age estimation can be improved by using gender-specific models and by estimating age in smaller age groups, and (ii) age estimation can benefit from a data fusion approach that combines different frameworks for automatic age classification.

(1) age estimation performance is better when gender information is used; (2) age estimation performance improves when the age group is small; (3) a data fusion approach gives the best age estimation performance.

(i) the combination of biologically inspired features with manifold learning improves age estimation; (ii) age estimation can be performed on smaller age groups; (iii) the combination of multiple age estimation frameworks can reduce the error of automatic age estimation.
